title: JobResult
description: What a job Smith (mode job, a callable-smith run on a prompt; engine/README.md, "Custom jobs and the SDK") writes to /work/out/result.json. The engine checks it (ReadResultDelegate) before its own rules; the Smith checks it with check-result job. Strict where the engine branches, any non-empty JSON where it only passes content on.

outcome.description: Branched on by the engine and the BPMN.

content.description: Passed on to the calling process as the run's result, never branched on: any non-empty JSON. A string is shown as itself; an object or array as a fenced JSON block.
